$comment: c158 roadmap C2 (D-LK-IMAGE-DATA-SLOT-EXTERN-ADDR, ELF/Mach-O positive witness): `FILE **pp = &stdout;` -- the address of libc's extern FILE* stream object in a file-scope initializer -- is LEGAL and satisfies cross-image pointer identity (C11 6.5.9). ELF exec emits a SYMBOL-BASED ABSOLUTE image relocation (R_X86_64_64 / R_AARCH64_ABS64 against the extern's dynsym row, in .rela.dyn: the slot is ZEROED on disk and ld.so writes the resolved &stdout in); Mach-O exec (stdio macro rewrites stdout->__stdoutp) emits a SYMBOL-BASED dyld BIND (c153 fold: slot zeroed on disk, dyld writes the resolved &__stdoutp) -- all three image families now share ONE shape. ⓘ THE ELF ARM USED TO BIND BY COPY RELOCATION (its .bss copy slot WAS the object, so &stdout was a genuine LINK-TIME address the apply could bake in with no .rela.dyn row at all). Copy relocation is DELETED (D-LK-ELF-COPY-RELOC-CLAIMS-ONE-NAME-OF-AN-ALIAS-SET: it claimed ONE name of an aliased libc object and SPLIT it), and its removal took that link-time constant with it -- ✔MEASURED, the first cut of the deletion baked symbolVa[extern], which is now the GOT SLOT, and THIS EXAMPLE went red at exit 1 with the pointer one indirection off, exactly as the red-on-disable note below predicts. ARE THE CONDITIONS OF THAT CATCH WORTH RECORDING: only a RUN leg saw it. The Windows ctest COMPILES every elf arm and runs none, so this example was GREEN on Windows while broken; the WSL leg is what reported it. The exec arm then adopted the same rows the ET_DYN arm had already emitted for the same reason, and a READ-ONLY (.rodata) item holding such an address now FAILS LOUD rather than baking a wrong pointer (a load-time write cannot reach a read-only page). Both make pp == &stdout hold -> exit 42; the extra *pp != stdout check proves the slot dereferences to the LIVE stream. The optimized arms prove the address materialization survives the release pipelines. This is the runtime counterpart to the fail-loud PE sibling extern_data_addr_reject_pe (PE has no symbol-based image reloc). ELF x86_64 witnessed locally under WSL (exit 42); the elf-arm64 (qemu) + macho-arm64 arms run on the linux/macos CI legs (SkippedCrossHost compile-clean elsewhere). Mach-O's symbol-based bind is additionally decoded structurally, host-independently, by MachoExecSourceExternSlot.StdoutAddrStaticInitEmitsSymbolBasedBindThroughShippedStdio. RED-ON-DISABLE: bake the indirection-slot VA instead of the symbol-based reloc -> pp is one indirection off -> pp != &stdout -> exit 1.
